```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
```

# Problem 1

## Data import
```{r}
CPS <- read.table("CPS.dat", header = TRUE)
head(CPS)
```


## (b)
```{r}
model <- lm(ahe ~ yrseduc + female + age + ne + south + midwest, data = CPS)

summary(model)

coeftest(model, vcov. = vcovHC(model, type = "HC1"))
```

## (h)
```{r}
# HC1 robust covariance matrix
V <- vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")

# Sandwich matrix (Sigma_hat)
Sigma_hat <- nobs(model) * V

# Print the full 7×7 matrix
print(round(Sigma_hat, 4))

# Print the 2×2 submatrix for beta5 and beta6
print(round(Sigma_hat[c("south", "midwest"),
                      c("south", "midwest")], 4))
```

## (m)
```{r}
# Full Sandwich Matrix
Sigma_hat <- nobs(model) * vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")

# Display the full 7×7 matrix
print(round(Sigma_hat, 4))

# Extract the 3×3 matrix for beta4, beta5, beta6
Sigma_sub <- Sigma_hat[c("ne", "south", "midwest"),
                       c("ne", "south", "midwest")]

print(round(Sigma_sub, 4))
```
